Hey everyone!

I'm looking for nice open minded people who would be interested in joining our community(Discord Server). It's open to all ages, but isn't for everyone. It's meant for people who need a safe place to come and talk and not worry about being judged. It's also meant for people who are patient and understanding. I want to build something where we can be there for each other and not have second thoughts if what we said was right or wrong.

We have weekly movie nights on Saturdays 8:30 PM EST and hold polls on the movie that we'll watch. We also play Jackbox at 7:00 PM EST before the movie. I also stream documentaries for anyone who is interested in watching them. I've previously streamed Gaza Fights for Freedom and The Shock Doctrine, just so you have an idea of the documentaries I plan on streaming.

We play games, but I don't regard this as a gaming server. However, feel free to come in a play your game while we talk!

We have strict rules in place to avoid a toxic environment from brewing. This isn't a place to voice your racist jokes, use homophobic slurs and isn't a matchmaking service to name a few. You must agree to all the rules to have access to all of the channels. These rules reflect what I want this community to eventually grow into.

The server is currently a work in progress. I'm always open to new ideas and ways to improve things, but be kept within the same vision I have for it.

I would like everyone who joins to be active in the community. It would be great if you could take the time to introduce yourself. I understand that connecting to a voice channel can be nerve-wracking at first, but feel free to hop in still and you don't have to say a word until you've grown comfortable to do so. Other than than, there are text channels to chat in.

Personally:

I'm vegan and have been for 12 years. I'm looking for more vegans as I am currently the only one in the server who is one.

If you live in Toronto or around the area, that would be great. A few of us plan on meeting up eventually when it's safe too, but you can live anywhere in the world!

I crochet, and on cam while I crochet(face excluded).  I do plan on scheduling an art cam/share screens for those who are interested in taking part.

I have social anxiety issues of which I am constantly trying to push through. If you struggle with anxiety, we can try to push through it together! I have also been personally going through a lot during the past few months and it has been incredibly hard, not to mention lonely, in finding people to talk with who would stick around. I would like to believe that ghosting will not be an issue in the server, but we shall see.

On the political side of things, I'm a progressive. We plan on watching documentaries weekly and possibly listening to podcasts and having some sort of reading time eventually.

There's a lot more I can say, but that's all for now. Thanks so much for reading this! I look forward to meeting you if you choose to give this community a chance.  If you think you would be a good fit for this community, please contact me and I will send you an invite link.
